newsitem.title: USA: MOYCO DISCUSSING WAFER TECHNOLOGY SALE.
newsitem.headline: MOYCO DISCUSSING WAFER TECHNOLOGY SALE.

text.p: Moyco Technologies Inc said Thursday it signed a non-binding letter of intent with Ashland Chemical Co covering the potential sale of Moyo's chemical mechanical polishing technology of wafers for the microelectronics industry to the Ashland Inc division.

The contemplated purchase will include worldwide rights to proprietary CMP slurry manufacturing processes, formulas, patent applications and trade secrets related to Moyco's slurry process, the company said.
Its statement said the proposed transaction combines an undisclosed lump sum payment and ongoing royalties.
Brown Brothers Harriman & Co is acting as Moyco's financial adviser. Closing is expected by the end of the summer.
Moyco said a final transaction is subject to due diligence, and approvals by the companies and appropriate government agencies.
If the purchase is completed, the business will become part of Ashland Chemical's Electronic Chemicals Division.
Moyco said it will continue to work with Ashland Chemical as a strategic alliance partner to develop products for semiconductor manufacturing applications.
